description.value: Stork Nest Inn is a family-owned boutique inn a short walk from downtown Smithers in the Bulkley Valley, operating since 2018. All rooms include a private washroom, bar fridge, flat screen TV, WiFi, and air conditioning units installed in 2023. A hot made-to-order breakfast starting at 6am is included with every stay, making it a practical base for early-starting cyclists exploring the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms a real, operating boutique inn in Smithers with booking functionality and detailed room/amenity information. WIFI is explicitly listed as a room amenity on the website, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. Breakfast starting at 6am qualifies as an early breakfast offering. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-250-847-3831 (local) while the website prominently displays 877-647-3831 (toll-free).
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM records +1-250-847-3831 (local Smithers number) but the website prominently displays 877-647-3831 (toll-free). Both may be valid, but should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable boutique inn in Smithers with a functioning website and confirmed amenities.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Hot breakfast included with every stay, served from 6am each morning with made-to-order eggs, sausages, ham, hash browns, pancakes, toast, cereals, fresh fruit, coffee, tea, and juices
